orcaInp.studio.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter that runs the Orbital Studio ML worker (`python/ml_worker.py`). Needs numpy, scipy, pandas, scikit-learn, joblib and threadpoolctl; dscribe + ase for the CM/SOAP/MBTR representations, xgboost for XGBoost. Use the full path of a venv/conda interpreter if `python` on PATH is not the right one.

orcaInp.studio.ml.maxJobs.description: Upper limit for the number of cores (n_jobs) an ML run may use.

notes: ML tab (src/studio/tabs/ml, webview/src/tabs/ml). Runs are stored in <storageDir>/ml_runs, the feature cache in <storageDir>/ml_cache; the worker is <extensionPath>/python/ml_worker.py (already shipped). orcaInp.studio.pythonPath is shared with any other tab that runs Python (e.g. PySCF jobs). No commands of its own: the tab is opened via orcaInp.openStudio with tab 'ml'; onNavigate accepts { view: 'new' | 'runs', run?: <id>, form?: <MlForm>, duplicate?: <id>, compare?: <ids> }.
